Subject: Your land dispute matter - O.S. No. 530/2025

Dear Mr. Pillai,

Thank you for meeting us on 25/07/2026 about your dispute with Vikram Pawar. As we understand it, the occupant claims ownership by adverse possession.

Our advice is to rebut the adverse possession claim with tax receipts showing continuous ownership. Please collect tax receipts showing continuous ownership and electricity bills and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs. 3,00,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
